name: TD Ameritrade Client Rewards Card

apr.notes: APR not available; product is discontinued and the official FAQ PDF is the only remaining source.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not documented in the remaining source.

base_rate.description: Historical earning rates are not documented in the remaining official transition FAQ.

rewards.redemption_notes: The official transition FAQ states that September 24 was the last day to redeem Client Rewards for a 10% bonus into an eligible TD Ameritrade account. Remaining Client Rewards transferred to TD Cash on October 6, 2021; this redemption bonus was not a purchase earning multiplier.

benefits.title: Redeem Points to TD Ameritrade Brokerage Account
benefits.description: Cardholders could redeem reward points for cash back deposited into a linked TD Ameritrade brokerage account.

notes: The official transition FAQ says the program ended and eligible accounts converted to TD Cash on October 6, 2021, after Charles Schwab acquired TD Ameritrade. The opening answer, next-steps answer and rewards section repeat the 2021 conversion date; the mail-arrival answer inconsistently prints October 6, 2020. Historical purchase earning rates and fees are not documented in this FAQ and are left unknown rather than reconstructed. The FAQ documents brokerage-account redemption, not a 2x earning category for brokerage deposits. Historical artwork provenance (checked 2026-10-21): the retained 2015-09-30 archive of the official TD Ameritrade Client Rewards site shows this image with alt text "TD Ameritrade Client Rewards Card Visa card". The linked image resolves to a 2015-09-19 archive capture of the TD Bank-hosted asset and was visually inspected as the white TD Ameritrade Client Rewards card; the pictured face carries a Visa Signature mark, which is recorded here as an observation only and does not change network_tier. It is a low-resolution 200x126 historical image; it is not evidence of lifecycle or the financial fields, which were not reverified in this artwork-only update. Network tier review (checked 2026-10-21): the stored network_tier none conflicts with the Visa Signature mark on the archived card art, but the tier is left unchanged because no terms document settles it. TD's 2018 Q4 agreement submission to the CFPB names only the "TD Ameritrade Client Rewards VISA® Card" with no tier. The 2015-2018 official product pages list generic Visa benefits. TD also published a Visa Signature vs. Visa Platinum comparison for its card lineup, so the art alone cannot rule out credit-line-based tiering. The schema requires a network_tier string and has no unknown value, so this needs a product-specific terms or benefits document before it can be changed.
